definitions.gloss: failure, lack of success, being unsuccessful
definitions.explanation: The state of not achieving the desired result or goal. A formal, somewhat literary word used to describe unsuccessful attempts, ventures, or outcomes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{実験|じっけん}→実験：03273_jikken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不成功|ふせいこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不成功|ふせいこう}だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: The negotiations were unsuccessful, but we'll wait for the next opportunity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{不成功|ふせいこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、あきらめず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}→挑戦：03495_chousen⟧し⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: He experienced failure many times, but kept trying without giving up.

notes:
A formal word formed with the prefix {不|ふ} (non-, un-) + ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧ (success). More literary and stiff than simply saying ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧. Often appears in written reports, academic writing, and formal assessments.

The common set phrase is {不成功|ふせいこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる (to end in failure).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不成功|ふせいこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる: to end in failure
- {不成功|ふせいこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦{試|こころ}み→試み：14221_kokoromi⟧: an unsuccessful attempt
- {不成功|ふせいこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧: cause of failure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧: failure — the most common, everyday word for failure; can refer to both the act of failing and the resulting state
- {不成立|ふせいりつ}: failure to materialize — used when something (a deal, agreement, meeting) fails to come together
- {未成功|みせいこう}: not yet successful — implies the possibility of future success
